data.name: Changelog_History016
data.value: · Reworked LDiff incremental updates, improving resource verification, old-file cleanup, and safe replacement. · Improved LDiff download resumption and recovery after interruption. Launching the game is blocked while an update is incomplete, with a prompt to resume it. · Improved LDiff download and patching progress displays and recovery reliability after errors. · Updated the documentation FAQ with guidance for errors 2, 0, 4 and 4201, and network errors on the login screen. · Prepared a small surprise for the client.

data.name: Changelog_History015
data.value: · Redesigned the application update dialog with consistent styling and clearer version information, release notes, and download progress. · The tutorial page opens on the first launch of each application version, and the documentation page includes video tutorial guidance. · Improved pre-download resource retrieval, with a safe fallback to the matching pre-download branch when the release branch is unavailable. · Strengthened LDiff prerequisite checks. Missing or damaged official incremental packages prompt users to pre-download or repair through the official launcher first. · Added LDiff patch records, original-file backups, and error recovery. Problematic files can be cleaned up and patched again. · Application updates temporarily preserve server-switch resources and restore them after the old app directory is removed, including recovery after an interrupted update. · Redesigned the server-switch completion dialog with consistent styling and the target server region and game version. · Improved RSA patch version matching and file verification. Launching stops with a message when no matching patch is available. · Fixed the unresponsive cancel button while downloading an application update. · Added tutorial guidance on Chinese characters in game paths, error 2, 0, 4, and Hook RSA memory-allocation failures. · Improved the Hook RSA injection flow to identify the actual game process and verify that the patch DLL loaded.

data.name: Changelog_History014
data.value: · Redesigned the application update dialog with consistent styling and clearer version information, release notes, and download progress. · The tutorial page opens on the first launch of each application version, and the documentation page includes video tutorial guidance. · Improved pre-download resource retrieval, with a safe fallback to the matching pre-download branch when the release branch is unavailable. · Strengthened LDiff prerequisite checks. Missing or damaged official incremental packages prompt users to pre-download or repair through the official launcher first. · Added LDiff patch records, original-file backups, and error recovery. Problematic files can be cleaned up and patched again. · Application updates temporarily preserve server-switch resources and restore them after the old app directory is removed, including recovery after an interrupted update. · Redesigned the server-switch completion dialog with consistent styling and the target server region and game version. · Improved RSA patch version matching and file verification. Launching stops with a message when no matching patch is available. · Fixed the unresponsive cancel button while downloading an application update.

data.name: Changelog_History013
data.value: · Added application self-updates: check the server recommended by the proxy, verify update packages, and restart automatically. · Added LDiff updates for CN and Global clients, with resumable downloads, local-file reuse, and integrity verification. · Redesigned the game download dialog with server-region selection, multiple voice packs, and download and required-space information. · Added private-server version recommendations and improved download pausing, resumption, progress, and install-path detection. · Improved server switching with MD5 verification of cached resources, transactional replacement, and rollback on failure. · Moved download settings to the home page and added 7.x RSA resources and a release-package SHA-256 generation script.

data.name: Changelog_History017
data.value: · Kun proxy mode: Choose the story or command server on the home page. Kun is enabled by default as a sub-option of the proxy. · Checks before launch: Checks the Global client and selected server version before launching. Incompatible clients are not started. · Clearer compatibility guidance: Region and version dialogs show the differences and let you go directly to server conversion or server selection. · Launch messages and proxy settings: Improved other launch error messages. Your custom proxy address is kept when Kun is turned off.

data.name: Changelog_StoryEndpointDescription
data.value: The story server now uses https://game.kunps.cn/ and queries the game version through /api/meta. The command-server address and API stay unchanged.

data.name: Changelog_DownloadSizeDescription
data.value: Calculate the required download from the installed version and target region, counting shared chunks once. The page and confirmation dialog show the same size; valid caches need no download.

data.name: Changelog_ClientDetectionDescription
data.value: Read the region and version only from client files and APMConfig.json, with timeouts, clear errors, and protection against stale requests. Synchronize the region after a successful switch.

data.name: Changelog_TunProxyDescription
data.value: Identify game requests by their TLS server name. Launcher APIs are no longer forced through the game proxy, and other HTTPS traffic stays end-to-end.

data.name: Changelog_VersionCheckDescription
data.value: Use only the numeric game version, excluding annotations and SDK build identifiers, and normalize its format. Show guidance and block launch when versions do not match.

data.name: Changelog_TransferFlowDescription
data.value: Use the same resource list for previews and downloads, fetch shared chunks once, and improve request cancellation. Batch log updates and display at most 200 lines.

data.name: Changelog_SurpriseDescription
data.value: A little surprise is waiting for you to discover.

data.name: Changelog_History018
data.value: · Version history: Expand or collapse archived release notes by version, in Chinese or English, even when offline. · Adjust background composition: Move default or custom still backgrounds horizontally and vertically, with a preview, automatic saving and a Center button. · Older Windows 10 compatibility: Keep .NET 10 with an adjusted CET compatibility flag for affected older Windows 10 systems, and include missing pages and built-in assets in published packages. · Acrylic dialogs and settings: Unify acrylic dialogs; correct switch-server confirmation and cancellation, uninstall placement, alignment and top spacing; prevent text from jumping when settings open. · High-quality backgrounds: Use a subtle dark tint outside the home page and keep local acrylic effects. Resize large images to the display's physical pixels to reduce jagged fine lines and adapt to DPI changes. · Theme-colored notices: The game-path warning follows the app accent color while keeping readable text in light, dark and high-contrast modes.
